text.tspan: Why a list of words needs counts at all
BPE learns by counting which two
sit next to each other most often. Handed a plain list, every word counts once, so "the" weighs exactly as much as "empyema" and the
come out in an arbitrary order. The ranks put the weight back where real text would put it.
